snippet.title: Bufo Jump - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Bufo Jump is a 3D platformer where you play as a frog on an adventure to stop a greedy corporation from destroying your pond.

Wishlist on Steam 🐸 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4175980/Bufo_Jump/

Hop, climb, and glide through colorful worlds, mysterious caves, and a menacing industrial site. Play as Bufo, a brave frog on a mission to save his pond from a greedy corporation polluting the land. Leap your way to the company's core and take back your pond.

FEATURES:
Charming 3D graphics
Different worlds to explore
Collect hidden items
Smooth and easy controls
Wholesome soundtrack
